title: Multi-Step Problem Solving
introduction: Build on earlier mathematics by studying multi-step problem solving.
definition: Identify the required quantity, choose the relevant information, represent the relationships using arithmetic, ratios or equations, calculate in a sensible order and verify units and reasonableness. An estimate can help catch mistakes.

examples.question: A shop buys 24 boxes of 36 pens and sells 75% of them.
A 12 m by 8 m garden has a 4 m by 3 m pond; grass costs RM5 per m².

exercises.question: A RM250 item is discounted 12%, then RM8 delivery. Total RM?
Travel 150 km at 60 km/h. Duration minutes?
A tank of 25 L is 3/5 full. Liquid L?
A cuboid 8 × 5 × 4 cm has a 2 × 2 × 2 cm piece removed. Volume?
Four numbers have mean 18. Three are 12, 17 and 20. Fourth?

summary: Identify the required quantity, choose the relevant information, represent the relationships using arithmetic, ratios or equations, calculate in a sensible order and verify units and reasonableness. An estimate can help catch mistakes.
